readerCopy.body: A small experiment can show that an old reaction is less permanent than the routine built around avoiding it made it seem. When Uranus sextiles Chiron, change and sensitivity cooperate, making a different route, format, tool, schedule, or response easier to test without dismantling every protection at once. The new experience can create evidence that the old rule no longer needs to govern the whole system. Change is most useful where the protection has outlived the danger.
